sources.title: ATO caps, limits and tax on super contributions
sources.fact: The contribution-cap guidance root the workflow sends the preparer to: concessional and non-concessional caps, carry-forward of unused concessional amounts and the non-concessional bring-forward rules, presented by income year. No cap amount, total-super-balance threshold or eligibility conclusion is adopted from this record.
sources.limitations: Caps, thresholds and bring-forward triggers are period-specific and change with legislation. Read the page for the relevant income year and the underlying provisions before concluding eligibility or any amount.

sources.title: Income Tax Assessment Act 1997
sources.fact: The legislation behind the two concessions the workflow reviews: ITAA 1997 s 291-20(3)-(7) addresses unused concessional contribution amounts, and s 292-85(2)-(7) addresses the non-concessional cap and bring-forward rules. On 22 September 2026, the Register served compilation C2026C00324, compilation 266 dated 1 July 2026, with the relevant provisions in volume 6. No cap amount, balance threshold or eligibility conclusion is adopted.
sources.limitations: The former C1997A00038 URL is not this Act and the browser redirected to a title-loading error. The correct title ID is C2004A05138. The Register labelled the retrieved compilation latest while displaying the period 1 July 2026 to 26 August 2026; this record does not establish the operative law for a later date. Check the work's period, subsequent amendments and application rules before using either concession. The existing human review date is retained; automated source verification is recorded in docs/source-review-2026-09-22.md.
